user.title: New wake-up light
user.description: Before each alarm the lights brighten slowly, like a sunrise. Switches turn on when the alarm rings.

data_description.name: For example the room, like "Bedroom".
data_description.lights: Brighten from 0 to 100% during the sunrise. Lights that can only turn on and off are switched on at the alarm time.
data_description.switches: Turn on at the alarm time, e.g. a coffee machine or a radio.
data_description.duration: How long before the alarm the lights start to brighten.
data_description.sunrise_colors: Color lights glow from deep red through orange to white; white lights go from warm to neutral white. When off, only the brightness changes.
data_description.lights_off_after: If nobody stops the alarm, the lights turn off this many minutes after the alarm time. Lights you changed in the meantime are left alone; switches stay on. 0 keeps the lights on.

error.no_devices: Select at least one light or switch.
